title: California DMV 2024 Autonomous Testing Mileage
summary: California DMV reports 4,498,066 public-road autonomous testing miles for December 2023 through November 2024.
key_findings: The total includes 3,945,171 miles with a safety driver and 552,895 fully autonomous miles.
Thirty-one companies held safety-driver testing permits, six held driverless testing permits, and three held deployment permits.
DMV says the reports are not designed for cross-company comparison.
why_it_matters: It adds a measured exposure record while preserving the distinction between testing and passenger service.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: The data are company-submitted and omit private-road, out-of-state, simulation, and lower-automation activity.
Miles alone do not establish safety, service, or commercial viability.
